sector: Luxury vacation rental collection of three villas above a cove, letting direct and to a small travel-agent trade channel, hospitality and travel.
founded_place_size: Three villas in Liguria, Italy, serving direct guests and a small travel-agent network.
about: Verranza Coastal Retreats is a collection of three coastal villas in Liguria, Italy. Guests book whole houses directly or through a small network of travel agents. The identity should reflect the real houses and their coastal setting, with honest photographs and a quietly used family monogram.
audience: Guests aged 35 to 60, American and Northern European families and groups of friends booking a whole house for a week, plus a small trade channel of travel agents working from printed rate cards. They pay for a real place and refuse anything that looks staged or cooked.
price_positioning: Upper-mid coastal rentals, typically 520 to 780 euros a night in season. The presentation should feel warm and restrained: honest light and true water, not a glossy resort treatment. Use rates_2027.csv for the actual rates in this commission.

typography: Verranza Coastal Retreats runs the booking heroes in four steps. Step 01 is the house name in Canela Deck Light at 72 px on 78 px with tracking of minus 10 units, and its first letter is drawn to twice the cap height of the rest of the word, roughly 144 px, so Casa Oliveto opens on one tall C. Step 02 is the standfirst, also Canela Deck Light, at 26 px on 30 px with tracking of minus 4 units, with Light the heaviest weight the serif may take. Step 03 is body and the booking line in Untitled Sans Regular at 20 px on 30 px, tracking 0, held to a maximum of 65 characters. Step 04 is rates and captions in Untitled Sans Regular at 15 px on 22 px with tracking of plus 8 units and tabular lining figures. In the brochure the name is 34 pt, body 10 pt on 15 pt and rates 9 pt. No numeral is ever set in the serif, and there is no gold.
voice: Warm, plain and place-first. We name the stone, the water and the afternoon light, and we never oversell. Example line: 'Three houses above the cove, let by the family who has kept them.'
brand_assets_status: The collection has never had a logo file. The monogram exists only as the wrought-iron plate the village smith cut when the first house was bought, and all we hold is a photograph of it on the gate. The travel-agent rate cards survive only as the file the printer sent to press last year, with no working source.
values: Honest representation of a real place, true water and true stone, and a family mark used quietly.
signature_type_move: Each house name opens with an oversized Canela Deck Light initial at twice the cap height of the rest of the word, and no numeral is ever set in the serif.

type_system.signature_move: Each house name opens with an oversized Canela Deck Light initial drawn to twice the cap height of the rest of the word, and every numeral stays in Untitled Sans tabular lining figures, never in the serif.
rules: No numeral is ever set in the serif. Every figure lives in Untitled Sans, tabular lining.
No weight above Light in Canela Deck.
The oversized initial is always the first letter of the house name, at twice the cap height of the rest of that word.
Rates and captions are Untitled Sans Regular only.
Name the stone, the water and the light, and never oversell.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are Lime Wash or Verranza Blue and nothing else. On Lime Wash, the house name, display lines and the booking-button label are Verranza Blue, and body text, rates and captions are Ink Charcoal, as on agentcard_2025_print.pdf. On Verranza Blue, all type is Lime Wash. The three accents are for hairline rules, dividers and small labels only, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: a text panel sits over or beside the photograph as a solid block.
palette_rules.forbidden: No gold, bronze, copper, silver or other metallic effect on any type, panel, rule, button or icon, and no colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette. The Casa Scogliera pool in scogliera_pool.jpg stays pale turquoise and is not pushed toward the deep blue of verranza_pool.jpg or oliveto_pool.jpg.
